name: Nettori Bakunyuu Mama Yuka ~Musuko no Dokusen Seiyoku ni Sareru ga Mama~
original_name: 寝っ取り爆乳ママ・唯華 ～息子の独占性欲にされるがママ～
source:
Atsushi was a college student in agony.
Until now it had been just Atsushi and his mother together.
He'd developed a mother complex. She was his alone! But now his step-father was returning home from business...

Atsushi couldn't control his jealousy. He went into a risky relationship with his own mother...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE068998.html]DLsite English[/url]]
